items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And I got Zooty's wife's brother, Cornet Flair.

ctx.x: Well he said to tell everybody how low for him too. Yeah, they look good, Manuel did. He's pretty heavy, but he's good health though.

And I go to work in Astoria, I mean entertainers, playing this band. And this was a band, that time was the talk of New Orleans. We kept it everything. Packed and jammed every night. Fake Marbles band was in there. And I got Zooty's wife's brother, Cornet Flair.
